skills_versions: To achieve this certification, you must hold the NSE 4 FortiOS certification and pass one of the proctored NSE 6 Cloud Security exams within 2 years.
The awarded certification will be valid for 2 years from the date the most recent requirement is completed.
Click the exam name for more details.
Fortinet NSE 6 - FortiMail WorkSpace Security Administrator*
*The exam will be available in Q3 2026.
We recommend taking the associated NSE courses to prepare for the certification exam.
